title: Phase 2: mdatron --json + cross-process emission + README + CLI integration tests
description:
v0.1.0 blocker.

Scope (per SO disposition 2026-06-02, amended 2026-06-07 to reverse earlier DR-F2 "strip the line" finding):
(1) Implement mdatron verify --json: emit Phase 0 output object on stdout.
(2) Keep stderr emission as rustc-shaped diagnostics (operator-readable when --json absent).
(3) Implement mdatron explain CODE against an embedded per-code catalog (MDATRON-E0001/E0002/E0050/E0070/E0080 baseline) and RETAIN the = explain: diagnostic line.
(4) Author mdatron README per DR-F1 - install + first run + schema/pattern example + relationship to vsdd.
(5) Add tests/cli_integration.rs (SE finding from same review).
(6) Add --quiet / --json / --log-level global args wired through clap.

Acceptance: mdatron verify --json emits parseable output; README covers three audiences; CLI integration tests cover clean run + finding emission + pipeline failure + missing schema directory; mdatron explain CODE returns the embedded catalog page for the v0.1.0 baseline codes.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 2 (row 14 amended 2026-06-07 via crosslink #13 Phase 4 to reflect SO disposition reversal). Blocked by Phase 0 + Phase 1.

Phase 3 cluster-batched cold-session: 18 reviews filed 2026-06-07 under mdatron/review-log/2026-06-07-*-phase-2-bundle.md; 129 per-domain findings filed as subissues of this issue.

Phase 4 + Phase 4-take-2 (2026-06-08): 91 of 215 review findings closed via 14 commits; remaining 124 open are correctly classified audit records (96 dismissed + 8 hallucinated + 20 blocked-by future-phase/umbrella with explicit DAG rationale).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
Closing per operator direction 2026-06-08.

Acceptance criteria met:
- mdatron verify --json emits the Phase 0 output object (mdatron-cli/tests/output_format.rs covers BC-1..BC-8)
- README authored covering 3 audiences (VSDD user, mdatron-only adopter, tool-author)
- CLI integration tests (mdatron-cli/tests/cli_integration.rs, 22 tests) cover clean run + finding emission + pipeline failure + missing schema directory + --quiet/--json combos + explain --json + explain --compact
- mdatron explain CODE returns embedded catalog pages for the 5 baseline codes (MDATRON-E0001/E0002/E0050/E0070/E0080), with --json (structured ExplainPage) + --compact (one-liner) variants

Cycle commits: implementation a000ebd; review-log moves 419dc9c; Phase 4-take-2 sweep 14 commits across mdatron + vsdd-cli (mdatron@883eaaf/ba61527/422c2dc/f45200b/28e9794/6a0fe22/f59c9f4/cea00ab/19d04d7 + vsdd-cli@91689e5/fc98fa4/3aad175/5d02683/b9ac1ee/f7633de).

Phase 3 cluster-batched review (129 findings) routed via crosslink subissues; 91 closed via code/disposition, 20 open with explicit block-by routing to future-phase issues (#15 collapse, #17 publish, L1 Phase 5, L2 events.jsonl, L3 vsdd-cli overlay), 104 open as audit records (96 dismissed + 8 hallucinated).

L4 (Raise-to-SO umbrella) closed after 2026-06-08 operator-disposition pass; remaining umbrella issues L1/L2/L3 stay open as planning anchors for future phases.

Phase 2 of binary-first refactor: done.
